classifier.program: master's students in Carnegie Mellon University's M.S. in Artificial Intelligence and Innovation (MSAII), a mix of US citizens and F-1 international students
classifier.fields: software engineering, machine learning, AI, data science that builds or trains models rather than reports or dashboards, and technical product management, meaning product management for a software or AI product or one that asks for a computer science or engineering background, including research internships in those areas, and technical customer-facing engineering such as solutions engineering, solutions architecture, sales engineering, and forward deployed engineering, for roles that ask for a computer science or engineering background or assign technical work
